sun.swing

接口 SwingAccessor.JTextComponentAccessor

  • 封闭类:
    SwingAccessor

    public static interface SwingAccessor.JTextComponentAccessor
    An accessor for the JTextComponent class. Note that we intentionally introduce the JTextComponentAccessor, and not the JComponentAccessor because the needed methods aren't override methods.
